tea.metaDescription: Discover how TropiNord sources character-rich tropical teas and supports smallholders.
tea.title: The Secret Power of Plants
tea.welcome: Welcome to our tea origin story rooted in Africa’s highlands and guided by respect for nature. For generations, communities have lived closely with their landscapes: listening to the seasons, honoring the plants, and turning leaves into comfort, care, and calm.
tea.p1: Across Africa, tea is more than a drink it, is a relationship with the land. Families have long relied on the forest’s apothecary: bitter leaves to steady the body, fragrant herbs to soothe, and roots that clear the breath and settle the mind.
tea.p2: Our partner growers cultivate whole-leaf teas among banana shade, mist, and red volcanic soils. Plucking is deliberate; leaves are carried by hand to small factories where withering, rolling, oxidation, and firing are tuned for each batch.
tea.p3: We focus on integrity and character herbal infusions, black, and green teas that taste of place. Nordic quality control and batch traceability ensure each bag is honest to its origin.
tea.p4: Your purchase sustains smallholders through fair pricing and training in soil health, shade management, and regenerative practices like composting and intercropping.
tea.p5: While our roots are in Africa, we are exploring future partnerships in the South Pacific. Wherever we go, the principle stays the same: respect the plant, respect the people, and let the land speak in the cup.

oils.metaDescription: How we source cold-pressed tropical oils with Nordic standards and support small producers.
oils.title: From Seed to Sacred Oil
oils.welcome: Our oils begin as seeds, kernels, and fruit gathered with care. Across Africa, plants are honored as living stores of nourishment and medicine shared in kitchens, on skin, and in rituals of everyday healing.
oils.p1: For generations, communities have pressed nature’s gifts into oils that comfort and restore: shea to soften and protect, coconut for shine and cooking, castor for strength and scalp, and palm varieties for heat and flavor.
oils.p2: We work with cooperatives that clean, dry, and cold-press in small batches to preserve delicate fatty acids, vitamins, and aromatics. Where needed, clarification is gentle and minimal.
oils.p3: Then we apply Nordic standards: lab checks for purity, batch IDs for traceability, and straightforward, low-impact packaging oil you can trust, true to its origin.
oils.p4: Your support funds farmer training in regenerative practices mulching, cover crops, water stewardship and safer processing, so families and landscapes can thrive.
oils.p5: We’re exploring future partnerships in the South Pacific for botanicals and oils that complement our African roots. Our promise is constant: honor the plant, honor the people, and deliver honest oil with nothing to hide.
